nodes.name: nodejs.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow ("Containerize PMS") that builds the Node.js application and publishes a multi-platform Docker image of the PMS app to Docker Hub whenever a semantic-version tag (e.g. 1.2.3) is pushed.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-job workflow triggered on tag push; installs dependencies with `npm ci`, runs `npm run build --if-present`, sets up Docker Buildx, logs into Docker Hub, derives image tags/labels via docker/metadata-action, and builds+pushes a multi-arch image (linux/amd64, linux/arm64/v8) for digitalsaleron/pms using pinned third-party action SHAs.
